data.name: LocalTitle
data.value: Start without installing a database server

data.name: LocalDescription
data.value: Choose Embedded SQLite and a persistent database path. FlowBlox creates the parent directory, database file and schema on first use; later runs keep the index. No Python, Docker or database extension is required. If the packaged SQLite native library is missing, repair/reinstall the matching FlowBlox build, then restart. SQLite: [SQLite documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/index.html)

data.name: RemoteDescription
data.value: For larger indexes choose a remote backend. Qdrant and Chroma collections are created automatically with cosine distance. Start a local server or use a hosted service, then configure Endpoint and credentials. A refused local connection raises Setup required; authentication and configuration errors remain ordinary operation failures. Pinecone requires an existing dense cosine index with the embedding dimensions; Collection selects its namespace. A local SQLite file still keeps hashes and document text. Qdrant: [Qdrant Quick Start](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/quickstart/) Chroma: [Set up Chroma](https://docs.trychroma.com/docs/run-chroma/client-server) Pinecone: [Create a Pinecone index](https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/indexes/create-an-index)

data.name: EmbeddingDescription
data.value: Use OnnxTextEmbeddingProvider for local embeddings or TextEmbeddingProvider for an OpenAI-compatible embedding API. For local inference, configure ModelFolder with model.onnx (or onnx/model_quint8_avx2.onnx) and matching tokenizer/configuration files. Supported transformer models use input_ids, attention_mask and last_hidden_state with mean pooling, plus tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, special_tokens_map.json, config.json and sentence_bert_config.json. Provision model files separately; Python and a startup script are not required for inference. The model is reused within a runtime; unchanged sources reuse stored vectors. A model change reindexes sources. If native ONNX libraries are missing, repair/reinstall FlowBlox. VectorTable returns matching passages as a DataTable; Search knowledge collects and formats excerpts for any downstream consumer.
